full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white graphic collage brings a young person's face forward from a crowded field of drawn marks. The face is nearly frontal and fills the middle of the frame, with large light eyes, a straight nose, and softly closed lips. Dark curly hair piles high across the top and merges into the heavy black background. One side of the face is sharply lit white, while the other is broken by deep black shadow and narrow engraved hatching. Around the head, the remaining space is filled almost edge to edge with small images: disembodied eyes, circular targets, tiny figures, angular letter-like fragments, arrows, checker patterns, and cut-paper silhouettes. These marks vary in scale and orientation, with the largest extra eye near the upper-left corner and denser miniature forms packed along the lower edges. A thin white outer margin and black inner frame contain the busy composition. The drawing combines fine pen linework, stark ink fills, halftone-like dots, and collage-style overlap; the face is relatively carefully modeled, while surrounding fragments remain rougher and more graphic. No color softens the contrast. Highlights on the eyes and bridge of the nose pull the viewer to the center before the peripheral symbols invite close inspection. Light seems to fall from the front-right, creating a bold diagonal division across the face, but the background works as a flat montage rather than a realistic space. The whole image feels alert and psychologically charged, held together by a clear central gaze amid restless black-and-white visual noise.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白图形拼贴让一张年轻面孔从拥挤的绘制痕迹中浮出。面孔近乎正对观者，填满画面中央，有明亮的大眼睛、笔直鼻梁和轻闭嘴唇。深色卷发在上方堆起，并与沉重黑背景合并。脸的一侧被鲜明照成白色，另一侧则被深黑阴影和细窄版刻排线打断。头周围剩余空间几乎贴边塞满小图像：脱离身体的眼睛、圆形靶心、微型人物、像字母的尖角碎片、箭头、棋盘花纹和剪纸剪影。它们尺度、方向不一，左上角有最大的额外眼睛，更密集的小形体挤在下边缘。细白外边和黑色内框约束繁忙构图。画法结合细密钢笔线、鲜明墨块、类似网点的点纹和拼贴式重叠；脸相对精心塑形，周围碎片则更粗犷、更图形化。没有颜色缓和对比。眼睛和鼻梁的高光先把观者拉向中央，随后周边符号引人近看。光似乎从右前方落下，在脸上制造醒目的斜向分割，但背景作为平面蒙太奇运作，而非真实空间。整幅图警醒而有心理张力，由清楚的中央凝视把躁动的黑白视觉噪声凝在一起。
style_prompt_en: High-contrast monochrome ink collage combines a carefully modeled central focal form with nearly edge-to-edge fragments of miniature graphic imagery. Solid black masses, clean white reserves, fine pen hatching, halftone dots, and abrupt cut-paper overlaps supply all tonal variation. Small circles, eyes, arrows, angular glyph-like shapes, and checker rhythms change size and direction rapidly around a stable center. One strong diagonal shadow gives the focal form depth, while peripheral imagery stays flat and restless. A narrow border keeps the visual density contained. The absence of color sharpens the alternation between black voids and crisp white highlights, creating an intense, alert, print-like surface that rewards close viewing.
style_prompt_zh: 高对比单色墨线拼贴把精心塑形的中央焦点与几乎贴边的微型图形碎片结合。大块实黑、干净留白、细钢笔排线、网点与突然重叠的剪纸边缘提供全部明度变化。小圆、眼形、箭头、尖角类字形和棋盘节奏在稳定中心周围迅速改变大小与方向。一道强烈斜向阴影给焦点形体纵深，周边图像却保持平面和躁动。窄边框束住视觉密度。缺少颜色让黑色空洞与锐利白高光的交替更尖锐，形成紧张警醒、值得近看的版画般表面。
theme_en: A young face emerging from a dense black-and-white collage of watching eyes and symbols
theme_zh: 一张年轻面孔从凝视的眼睛与符号构成的黑白密集拼贴中显现
name: Yonatan Frimer
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
